title: Management Report Readability and Executive Narrative
goal: Improve AegisPT management reports so a human executive or non-technical manager can read the report end-to-end without being buried in technical details, commands, scanner output, or raw evidence noise.
scope: Backend report generation, report templates, React v2 Report Center preview, and tests for management-report content quality.
generation_reason: The operator noted that management reporting must be genuinely readable by humans and should avoid excessive technical detail.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: current report generation and React v2 Report Center

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus on management-report readability and executive narrative. Do not rebuild the entire reporting engine, alter finding schemas, or add unrelated UI redesigns.
constraints.safety_reframe: Reporting-only change. Do not run scans, create tasks, approve proposals, mutate runtime gates, expand scope, materialize credentials, or access live targets.

success_criteria: Management reports start with a plain-language executive summary that explains business impact, confidence, and overall risk posture.
Findings are grouped by business impact and remediation priority rather than scanner/tool order.
Technical details, commands, raw stdout, payloads, and long evidence refs are moved to a separate technical appendix or hidden from the management view.
Each management claim still maps to evidence references internally so the report remains evidence-first.
The report clearly separates confirmed risk, suspected risk, untested areas, and residual gaps in non-technical language.
The report includes an action plan with owner-friendly remediation themes, priority, expected effort, and validation guidance.
React v2 Report Center can preview or select the management-readable report variant without confusing it with the technical report.
Tests prove the management report avoids raw commands/stdout-heavy sections while preserving evidence references and findings traceability.

acceptance_criteria: Backend tests cover management-report generation with high-level narrative, business impact grouping, and evidence traceability.
Backend tests prove raw command/stdout-heavy details are excluded from the management body.
React v2 tests cover management-report preview or report variant selection when UI changes are made.
No runtime dispatch, scanning, approval, credential, or scope mutation occurs.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains.

out_of_scope: Generating legal, compliance, or insurance attestations beyond evidence-backed report language.
Running scans or changing assessment runtime behavior.
Auto-remediation, proposal approval, or task dispatch.
